scope: Decoded/native evidence for the ACNH 1.0.0 new-player route from boot/title through registration, map selection, NewGame and the first landing sequence. No live game or Godot implementation is claimed.

status_legend.EF: Direct action, branch, or key in decoded EventFlow.
status_legend.TBL: Decoded source table, including BCSV parameters.
status_legend.STRUCT: Parsed asset or stage structure; raw asset presence is only claimed where its exact extracted member is cited.
status_legend.PSEUDO: Static page/layout identifier correspondence; caller, loader, or runtime instantiation remains unproved.
status_legend.NATIVE: Original native code behavior exercised or statically resolved; fixture/cache limits are retained.
status_legend.CAT: Catalogue-only candidate; raw Model/Sound archives are not present in the supplied source inventory.

base_game.status: ACNH 1.0.0 B_data / main NSO evidence used by the existing local source manifest
base_game.notes: Source IDs, B_data paths, and file SHA-256 values below come from output/manifest.json.

supplemental_romfs.status: STRUCT comparison corpus; exact game version is not established
supplemental_romfs.version_note: The inventory says 'Compare content evidence; do not infer exact version from filenames.' Its 1,171 identical files match the original set, but the specific UI/message assets cited below are new_path records unless otherwise established. They are not asserted as exact 1.0.0 assets.

route.name: Boot save load
evidence: On SaveProcIsSuccess case 0, calls SaveCopyToEnv, CreateStaticField, System_BootSequence_LangChk:Root, then System_BootSequence_PcSaveChk:Root.
route.limit: This proves the decoded boot load sequence and branch labels, not save-media durability or the meaning of every boolean branch.

route.name: Title to new-player order stage
route.limit: The exact CharacterOrder-to-IdrAirPortDemoDeparture handoff is OPEN.

route.name: Departure stage and registration launcher
evidence: Actor labels rco and rct and CameraTag:Root are structurally present; rco/rct are at (120,160,0), camera at (160,160,0).
route.limit: No player spawn or CharacterOrder handoff is proved by this stage structure.

route.name: Name and birthday registration
route.branch_context: Apply reaches this step on both validated-save and new-prologue branches; the latter continues when cLand:ValidateVillageSave is OFF.
route.limit: Action/result names do not alone prove the final durable save writer or UI handler implementation.

route.name: Avatar creation
route.limit: The consumer linkage from handler to a particular layout is PSEUDO, and the native result-to-save mapping is OPEN.

route.name: Region/weather-area choice
route.evidence: Choice branches call EnvWeatherArea with cWeatherArea_North or cWeatherArea_South before TerrainSelect. This regional weather-area selection is distinct from the four map preview cards.
route.limit: Exact persistence field for this choice is OPEN.

route.name: Island/map choice
evidence: TerrainSelect displays message key 021, calls UIMapSelectHandling, then SaveSetFromUIResult {SaveType:cVillage}.
Message keys 022/023 and GeneralTalkChoice4 follow the returned result.
route.limit: The selected cVillage result is not directly joined to a specific FieldMainFieldParam row, preview-map identity, or final saved template.

route.name: End of character creation / opening movie handoff
evidence: Sets demo time to 14:00 and cLockDemo.
Sets cPlayer:MakeVillagePlayerFlag, cLandTemp:IsFirstPrologue and cLand:OpeningSeqBGMChangeCounter=1; reserves PrologueTanukichi.
route.limit: The precise system-flow invocation that enters System_GrowUp:NewGame from cOpeningMovie is OPEN. The new-player branch does not set DoneCharacterCreation/EntryGame at this point; those flags are in the validated-save ON branch.

route.name: NewGame setup and landing stage request
evidence: Calls DateCheck; game-process Root and FirstDay; weather FirstDay.
Calls SaveGrowUp {GrowUpSituation:cStart}, unlocks time, then requests cMainFieldDemoLanding.
route.limit: SaveGrowUp is an EventFlow action in this sequence; durable save commit semantics are OPEN.

route.name: First landing cinematic and airport arrival stage
route.evidence: Runs the landing cut, UILogoAppear {SelectKind:cTitle}, Flight_Landing trigger and requests cFrontOfAirPort.

stage_source.notes: Includes landing-flow launcher and AirportDemoAirplaneShadow actor; it does not establish a player spawn or model import.

save_evidence.interpretation: The native save-layout crosswalk identifies a birthday field and related native routines, but does not prove the EventFlow cBirthDay result writes that member. Name, cCharaMakeResult and cVillage final offsets/writers remain OPEN. Boot SaveSimpleLoad and NewGame SaveGrowUp are not treated as proof of first durable save commit.

key_relations: FieldMainFieldParam.FieldData values resolve to *_LandMaking.byml, *_EventPlaza.byml, structure-preset and item-preset resources.
FieldOutsideTemplate stores UniqueID, TemplateKind, sea/wind data and outside-part slots; FieldOutsideParts supplies type-filtered part IDs/model names.
terrain_world_data.limit: These tables establish terrain/world data families and row relationships, not which field preset or map was selected by cVillage.

terrain_world_data.evidence: 528 native selector fixture cases had no mismatches. With reconstructed typed caches and the original 96-row FieldMainFieldParam plus 36-row FieldOutsideTemplate inputs, 3B_S2 / 3B_SE / 3B_SW pools contain 12 templates each; each of 96 presets maps to one 12-template candidate pool.
terrain_world_data.limit: The fixture proves a coast/outside-template candidate selector, not the player's four-card choice or a chosen saved island. Original cache initialization, live RNG integration, actual map/template loading and selected cVillage-to-preset join remain OPEN.

terrain_world_data.evidence: LandMaking grids are 112x96; coast subdivision is 7x6 segments of 16x16; native segment centers are 160 units apart. PBC runtime records are 52 bytes and differ from 14-byte preset records; converter/loader linkage is unresolved.
terrain_world_data.limit: Terrain dimensions are supporting world-data context, not proof that registration's selected map has loaded or that Godot should use a particular transform.

model_sound_catalog_candidates.archive_availability: raw Model sources are absent; generated paths are references only
model_sound_catalog_candidates.limit: Candidate IDs align by name with airport-stage context only; no actor/structure consumer, raw file, rig, transform, collision, or preview-map model join is established.

model_sound_catalog_candidates.archive_availability: raw Sound sources are absent; generated paths are references only; inventory has zero raw path matches
model_sound_catalog_candidates.limit: EventFlow BGMPropertyControl IDs 55/54 and Flight_Landing are call keys only; they do not prove these catalogue entries are the corresponding runtime sounds.

open_joins: UITitleResult -> CharacterOrder stage and CharacterOrder -> IdrAirPortDemoDeparture transition.
EventFlow UI handler -> instantiated UI page/layout, user input events, and actual page animation triggers.
Exact 1.0.0 identity of the supplemental Layout and MSBT resource files.
Four CharaMakeMap card preview image/model source and card-to-cVillage result mapping.
cVillage result -> FieldMainFieldParam UniqueID / FieldData -> selected initial map and coast/template result.
Region weather-area setting -> exact save member.
cPlayerName, cBirthDay, cCharaMakeResult and cVillage -> final save writers / first durable save commit.
cOpeningMovie -> System_GrowUp:NewGame dispatcher and exact cFrontOfAirPort stage launch ownership.
Departure/landing stage actors -> raw Model archive members, skeleton/animation clips, transforms, collision and visible initial player spawn.
BGMPropertyControl/Flight_Landing -> raw Sound members and playback parameters.
godot_conversion_notes: Treat BFLYT/BFLAN and static parameter names as source of truth; recreate layout hierarchy, anchors and animations in Godot UI only after exact 1.0.0 asset identity and handler bindings are resolved.

BNTX textures require NVN/GX2 block-format decoding to ordinary image textures; preserve channel swizzles, dimensions and alpha interpretation before importing. Parent CharaMakeMap BNTX does not prove the four preview images.

BCSV/BYML table rows should first be normalized into typed Godot data resources while retaining source IDs, enum labels, ordering and unknown fields. Keep map-card choice, preset selection, coast-template selection and PBC loading as separate stages until proven linked.
Do not convert catalogue GLB/OGG reference paths into runtime assets; raw Model and Sound archives are absent in this input set.
